section.heading: Fees.
section.text: *NOTE: This codification is not the most current. To see the current law, click this link Current Version*

para.text: The owner of a vacant building shall register the building and pay registration fees within 90 days after it becomes a vacant building.
Fees for registration and renewal shall be as follows:
The initial registration fee shall be $350; and
The renewal registration fee shall be $500.
The Mayor may increase the fees set forth in subsection (b) of this section through rules issued pursuant to section 21.
